statement: In the standard full pants extension E0=C2(a) coproduct C2(b) coproduct C2(c), the exact triple a,b,g c g^-1 with x=ba, y=ca and g=x[x,y]x^-1 contains one representative of every section class. Its orientation-kernel generators x,Y=g y delta(g)^-1 induce the identity on full abelianization and automorphisms on every maximal pro-p quotient, but generate a proper full subgroup. The specified A5 quotient sends the triple to D10 and its kernel generators to C5, while the original full kernel maps onto A5. The D76 incidence cokernel has an explicit five-dimensional finite augmentation quotient. The same map proves Y is not conjugate to any unit power of the original y, retaining the extra cusp-alignment condition of the distinguished D76 problem.
where_proved: Part D, statement D.77; work/part_c/d77.tex; code/part_c/pants_incidence_limit.py and its exact output
depends_on: D34 standard inversion extension and its three actual section classes; D76 actual section augmentation module and incidence cokernel; explicit mutually inverse full coproduct/semidirect maps; the all-prime Frattini and finite-generation Hopficity arguments proved directly; exact A5 multiplication and generated-subgroup certificate
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Section 24, folio 147 verso, scan 293; Part D(b), the full loop-outer finite-action and actual peripheral-recognition problem for type (0,3)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The full orientation kernel is identified by inverse generator maps, the three conjugacy labels are retained in the actual C2^3 quotient, and both properness and the failed original-y cusp alignment are detected by the named full A5 homomorphism.
computational_checks: Executed code/part_c/pants_incidence_limit.py: 20 exact free-word, abelian-coordinate and finite-permutation checks. The original three-factor image and orientation-kernel image both have order 60; the chosen triple has image order 10 and its two kernel generators have image order 5. JSON and stdout are adjacent. The universal pro-p and incidence-cokernel assertions are proved in the text.
notes: This is a proved explicit counterexample to the generation test consisting only of one representative of each section class plus full images in all maximal pro-p quotients. It does not supply a counterexample to D76's distinguished cusp-aligned triple. The full endomorphism x->x,y->Y commutes with standard inversion but fails the original-y peripheral condition, as its named finite image has order one instead of two. No recognition or exhaustion conclusion is inferred.
